objective: essential edit action reachable in a visible representation
reviewWarnings: nested scroll owners without demonstrated harm
evidenceRules: Measure objective failures in context, inspect actual rendered interfaces and retain warnings separately. Hooks, skill calls and automated checks do not prove design quality. Link guidance use to both command evidence and implemented decisions; self-report alone is insufficient.
review: Controller measurement/source inspection is unblinded. Attempt a separate label-blinded review of screenshots only; disclose same-model and single-rater limitations. No combined aesthetic/functional score.
sampling: One independent generation per condition; exploratory paired comparison, no statistical or causal generalization.
